title: Cargonaut user menu — FR-206
description: F2 user-menu schema. Loaded from ~/.config/cargonaut/menu.toml (user-wide) merged with ./.cargonaut.menu.toml (per-directory; auto-loaded when focused pane's cwd contains it). Macros (all shell-quoted by impl per FR-205/206/207): %f / %F (focused active/passive), %d / %D (active/passive dir), %t / %T (tagged list, NUL-separated — %T returns JSON array for structured consumers), %s / %S (tagged-or-focused), %b (basename), %x (extension), %% (literal).

label.description: Human-readable text rendered in the F2 popup.

key.description: Optional single-key shortcut (lowercase letter or digit) to invoke directly from the popup.

command.description: Shell snippet, runs via $SHELL -c with macros expanded + shell-quoted.

items.description: Visibility guard. Built-ins: is-file, is-dir, is-symlink, is-executable, has-tagged, match-glob='*.rs', match-mime='text/*', has-cap='execute'.

condition.description: Entry rendered iff all conditions are satisfied for the current selection.

background.description: Run command detached; entry returns to menu immediately. Output captured to tasks panel (FR-016).
